description: Harissa rigatoni. Stresses 'harissa oil' vs the ingredient 'harissa olive oil', a hyphen variant (red-pepper vs red pepper), and pervasive salt only on first use.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni until al dente.
Meanwhile, warm the harissa oil in a skillet and stir in the tomato paste.
Add the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant.
Add the heavy cream and a splash of pasta water, then toss in the drained rigatoni.
Remove from heat and stir in the Parmesan until melted.
Season with salt, garnish with torn basil, and serve.
